memberdef.name: npu_measure_freq

briefdescription.para: Mesure the actual frequency of the FPGA.

detaileddescription.para: VART ML's frequency counters work by dividing the frequency to be measured by a factor, then by counting how many periods of a reference clock the divided clock's period spans.

parameterdescription.para: Select the clock whose frequency to measure.
index of the IP being accessed.

simplesect.para: int The Vart ML error (vart_ml_error_id) code of the operation.
